title: boot: a fresh database logs "UNIQUE constraint failed: sys_migration.id" on first start
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: a first `objectstack dev` on an empty SQLite file logged `WARN Insert operation failed {"object":"sys_migration","error":{"message":"UNIQUE constraint failed: sys_migration.id …"}}` during boot.

**Who acts on it:** objectstack triage (runtime / migrations owner). ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

The server starts normally, but an empty database should not hit a duplicate migration row; the warning suggests two writers record the same migration.

## Reproduction

`pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p <port> -d file:<new file>` with `OS_PORT=<port>`; grep the log for `sys_migration`.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Find the second insert of the same migration id on first boot; make the record an upsert or give it one writer.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectstack (open and closed), *sys_migration unique constraint failed fresh boot warn*: 6 hits (0 open, 6 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectstack#20768 (closed) — closed 2026-09-30 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#20818): same first-boot sys_migration false-alarm family; this card is a different error (UNIQUE constraint)
  - objectstack-ai/objectstack#20648 (closed) — sys_migration boot-noise family
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: sys_migration unique constraint failed first boot · migration recorded twice
